questions.question_text:
Input and Output, shared input/steps:
Input: SCALE WRAP POCKET YESTERDAY REMEMBER
Step I: WRAP SCALE POCKET REMEMBER YESTERDAY
Step II: WRP SCL PCKT RMMBR YSTRDY
Step III: PRW CLS CKPT BMMRR DRSTYY
Step IV: PR23 CL19 CKP20 BMMR18 DRSTY25
Step V: 46 38 60 72 125

Q12. In step III, how many letters are there in the English alphabetical series between the 4th letter of the 3rd word from the left end and the 2nd letter of the 4th word from the right end? (Take letters within each word from the left.)
questions.explanation: The third word is CKPT, whose fourth letter is T. The fourth word from the right is the second word, CLS, whose second letter is L. Seven letters (M through S) lie strictly between L and T.
questions.source: INPUT OUTPUT MAINS SETS by Arpit sir (1).pdf, physical p. 6, Q12

Q24. Which option(s) are definitely true?

options.B: 30 45 60 105 102 is Step IV of the given input
options.C: The sum of the highest and second-lowest numbers in Step V is 240
options.D: 34458 34566 34568 34589 34679 is not Step II of the given input

questions.explanation: Option B is false because Step IV begins 45, 30, 60. Step V sorts as 15, 30, 51, 90, 210; highest plus second-lowest is 210+30=240, so C is true. D is false because its sequence exactly matches Step II.
questions.source: INPUT OUTPUT MAINS SETS by Arpit sir (1).pdf, physical p. 9, Q24

Q33. If the letters within each Step IV word are arranged in English alphabetical order, how many letters of the alphabet lie between the 4th letter of the 2nd word from the left and the 3rd letter of the 5th word from the left?
questions.explanation: Alphabetizing ZLXWM gives LMWXZ, whose fourth letter is X. Alphabetizing RFOIH gives FHIOR, whose third letter is I. Fourteen letters (J through W) lie between I and X.

Q35. Which option(s) are definitely true?

options.A: Step I is MYSTERY PLASTIC COMMAND NERVOUS LEISURE
options.B: In Step III, the second letter of the second-last word from the right is O
options.C: In Step II, the dictionary order is AICLPST AOCDMMN EEIULRS EMRSTYY EOUNRSV

questions.explanation: A is false: Step I places COMMAND before PLASTIC. B is true because the second-last word from the right is EOUNRSV, whose second letter is O. C gives the five Step II words in dictionary order. Thus only B and C are true. The printed key B disagrees.
questions.source: INPUT OUTPUT MAINS SETS by Arpit sir (1).pdf, physical p. 13, Q35
